info.title: Teyvat.me API
info.description: Your Genshin Impact accounts, snapshots, wishes and plans on Teyvat.me. Unofficial fan project. Docs: https://teyvat.me/developers/api

get.description:
The user, your rate limits, and what this token may do.

Scope: any token. Bucket `read`: global only.

buckets.description: Per minute; null: only the global limit

write.description: Areas it may change; it reads every area

token.description: null when called with the website session

post.description:
Send the file as `application/json` (gzip with `Content-Encoding: gzip`) or `multipart/form-data` with a `file` part. `?timestamp=` (Unix ms or ISO 8601) dates it when the file does not. The same data again is `unchanged` and stores nothing. Daily snapshot and storage quotas apply.

Scope: snapshots · Write. Bucket `upload`: 6 / min free, 20 / min supporter, per account.

default.description: Error (rate_limited, too_many_items, key_too_long, daily_upload_limit, storage_quota, uploads_blocked)

post.description:
Keeps the newest snapshot per day or Monday week (on the clock `offsetMinutes` from UTC) from before `before` (Unix ms) and deletes the rest at once, no trash. `dryRun` only counts. Owner only.

Scope: snapshots · Write. Bucket `destructive`: 2 / min free, 2 / min supporter, per account.

get.description:
What Capture sent since the newest snapshot (live sync): the changes as stored, GOOD-X paths and values. Apply them to `/good` yourself.

Scope: snapshots · Read. Bucket `read`: global only.

data.description: The open live journal: `open`, `base`, `seq`, `changes` (GOOD-X changes since the base)…

get.description:
Every stored pull, newest first. `?banner=` keeps one UIGF banner type.

Scope: wishes · Read. Bucket `read`: global only.

id.description: The game’s id (synthetic below 10^18 for pulls from a paimon.moe backup)

gachaType.description: The game’s type (400 = the second character banner)

time.description: As the game writes it, on the account’s server clock: "YYYY-MM-DD HH:MM:SS"

key.description: GOOD key; null when not in the table

post.description:
A UIGF (v3 or v4) JSON, a paimon.moe CSV, Excel export or backup, as the body. Pulls already stored are skipped; a file with several accounts imports the one with this account’s UID.

Scope: wishes · Write. Bucket `wish-import`: 2 / min free, 6 / min supporter, per account.

delete.description:
At once, no trash. Owner only.

Scope: wishes · Write. Bucket `destructive`: 2 / min free, 2 / min supporter, per account.

get.description:
Computed: every active goal together, costed with the Planner’s own math against the newest capture’s bag (with your hand edits), then what is still missing, the farm estimates (resin, runs, domains, weekly bosses, ley lines) and what today’s open domains can farm on the account’s server. The Farm view also applies the goals’ priority order and its filters; this is the plan for all goals at once. Custom characters and weapons are listed in `skipped`.

Scope: planner · Read. Bucket `farm`: 6 / min free, 20 / min supporter, per account.

data.description: `missing` materials, `plan` (groups, domains, weekly, leyLines, total), `today`, `mora`, EXP totals
